critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2000 lines — the persistent recommendation from iter 6/7/8 to split into routers still applies; the new _reconcile_intent helper and expires_at overrides add more surface area here.

_reconcile_intent runs synchronously inside GET /deposits/crypto/{id} and GET /links/payments/{payment_id} on every poll. If izipay.get_payment_intent has multi-second latency this will slow down every UI countdown tick. Consider caching the last reconcile timestamp per-doc (e.g. reconcile at most once every 15s) or moving reconciliation to a background task.

expires_at is now overridden to now+10min regardless of what IziPay returned in intent.expiresAt. The vendor-side expiry is stored as izipay_expires_at but never enforced. If IziPay expires the intent before our 10-min UI countdown finishes, our UI still says 'time remaining' but a webhook confirmation might not arrive. Consider min(izipay_expires_at, now+10min) or surfacing both.

In /api/links/pay the currency guard raises 400 before any pydantic-level validation of link amount for free-amount links — that's fine, but the message 'Ce lien n\'accepte pas les paiements crypto (devise différente de USDT)' is French-only. Since payment links are consumed by end-customers whose locale is unknown, consider an i18n hook or an English fallback.

admin_cleanup_test_users deletes db.link_payments.delete_many({}) — this wipes ALL link payments in the collection, not just those tied to deleted users. Comment says 'link payments are tied to links (already deleted)' but only user-owned links were deleted; if a super_admin happened to own payment_links, their link_payments records also get wiped. Low risk today (only one super_admin) but the {} filter is a footgun.

record_tx metadata now includes deposit_address and tx_hash. The user-facing transaction history endpoint should confirm these fields are returned (spot-checked, they are stored on tx.metadata). Item #4 of the request 'Transaction history for crypto must include reference, amount, coin, network, tx_hash, date, status' — verify the frontend History page actually renders tx_hash & network from tx.metadata; this was not part of the review file list so I did not deep-test the frontend History rendering. Recommend main agent verify with a UI screenshot.
